title: Weak and standard one-sided randomized recognition
statement: Let $E$ be a verifier model whose efficient verifiers are closed under the specified disjunction of polynomially many random-tape tests. For every natural number $c$ and every language $L$, weak one-sided recognition—an efficient verifier with perfect rejection outside $L$ and acceptance probability at least $\min(2/3,(|x|+1)^{-c})$ on inputs in $L$—is equivalent to standard one-sided randomized recognition, with acceptance probability at least $2/3$ on inputs in $L$ and perfect rejection outside $L$.
hypotheses_covered: The verifier model $E$ is closed under the specified polynomially many-test disjunction construction.
$L$ is a language of bit strings.
